dedupe_keys.name: reference measurement systems for the calibration of instrument transformers under power quality phenomena and their uncertainties

description: Letizia, Palma Sara and colleagues publish this resource through the source community. National metrology institutes developed and characterised reference systems for instrument-transformer calibration under power-quality disturbances. Coverage includes extended generated waveforms, improved uncertainty characterisation and combined transformer-calibration setups. The paper explicitly reports new tests performed with these physical reference systems. Related project measurement archives retain their particular instrument and influence-factor components. The abstract does not give a single uncertainty value applicable to every system, and a common software platform is not inferred. Zenodo supplies the descriptive publication with open access under cc-by-4.0. The publication does not establish public access to an implementation or its separate licence. A limitation is that complete implementation or measurement settings cannot be reconstructed from descriptive metadata alone. Related experimental components and publications retain their distinct roles; separate deposits are not assumed to provide independent observations.
